arms.plate: .ui-key-hint { align-items: center; height: 16px; padding: 0 4px; border-radius: 4px; background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 14%, transparent); font-weight: var(--weight-emphasis, 600); }
arms.chip: .ui-key-hint { gap: 3px; align-items: center; } .ui-key-hint-key { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 16px; height: 16px; margin: 0; padding: 0 3px; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 4px; background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 14%, transparent); font-weight: 500; }
arms.outline: .ui-key-hint { gap: 3px; align-items: center; } .ui-key-hint-key { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 16px; height: 16px; margin: 0; padding: 0 3px; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 35%, transparent); }
